promptHints: Interpret the diagram (an attached PlantUML/draw.io file, or the @startuml block in the request) and write a complete, build-ready implementation plan from it. Every step must trace back to a diagram element. It MUST contain concrete code snippets for the features and MUST end with a "## Clarifications (Q&A)" section reproducing the questions and the user answers below so the reviewer can see them.

inputs.directive:
## Revise to address the review

A reviewer found issues with the previous plan. Re-read the diagram and re-plan from scratch (cold start), addressing EVERY critical and major finding in the review below. Preserve the "## Diagram trace" and "## Clarifications (Q&A)" sections.

description: Reads a PlantUML or draw.io diagram (activity/flow, sequence, state, class/component) and turns it into the implementation plan, every step traced to a diagram element.
